buckets.description: At least one CPT/quantity bucket is required.

items.description: An exact CPT (Critical Pull Time) and the quantity due at it.

cpt.description: The last moment a parcel in this bucket can be manifested and still make its truck.

quantity.description: Units due by this CPT. int64, not int32: the impl and its JSONB store accept quantities across the full 64-bit range.
